findings.evidence: Double(_:) parses inf/nan/1e400; reaches UI via handleIncomingData. No value.isFinite guard, defeating the no-echo-untrusted-feed contract.
Only .connecting->.connected transition is on a received message; quiet pairs stay 'connecting'; successful ping does not promote state.
Deselect during backoff: symbol already absent from webSocketTasks, so disconnectWebSocket never runs; connectionStates stuck at .error, reconnectAttempts leaked.
switch keys off signed value not magnitude; price("-2000")="-2,000.0000". Cosmetic; non-negative feed makes it unreachable live.
.priceUpdated posts object:nil; refreshMenuItems rebuilds all 7 rows per tick though one changed. Bounded to menu-open + <=7 rows.
Per call reallocates NSMutableParagraphStyle, 5 NSTextTabs, re-resolves NSFont(name:size:); none depend on price data.
Posts .connectionStateChanged regardless of isMenuVisible; dataDidChange early-returns when closed, so post is wasted. Inconsistent with F7 price-path gating.

findings.reason: Deliberate clarity-over-speed trade-off (typed decode over a fragile manual scan); negligible cost at <=7 symbols and invisible to users. A faster manual extractor would be more fragile against the known Binance schema for no perceivable gain.
findings.evidence: Per trade JSONDecoder parses entire payload to read only 'p'. Already documented as a clarity-over-speed trade-off.
attributedTitle overrides title in AppKit; item.title never read. plainMenuTitle re-implements MenuRowText.make in a divergent format - untested drift trap.
menuFetchDebounce=10 and menuTabStops=[30,80,180,280,360] hard-coded in AppDelegate; siblings live in AppConfiguration. Convention drift.
menuFont==statusBarFont==Menlo and menuFontSize==statusBarFontSize==12.0; four constants for two values, no call site distinguishes. Drift risk.
